# Design reference attribution — unslop

This project uses the visual-audit approach and selected right-to-left interface guidance from **unslop**, created by **Damir Sokolovsky (@heydamir)**, as a supplementary design-quality reference.

- Original repository: https://github.com/heydamir/unslop
- Reference used: `skills/unslop/references/rtl.md`
- License of the referenced work: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0): https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
- Author profile: https://github.com/heydamir

## Nature of use

The project adopts selected design principles as guidance: correct document-level RTL direction, logical layout properties, isolation of mixed-direction text, readable Arabic typography and line height, consistent spacing, restrained interface chrome, purposeful color, and iterative visual review.

No unslop source files, scripts, images, example screens, or code have been copied into this repository. The product's visual identity, components, styles, and implementation remain independently authored for نَوَاة.

This attribution records the design reference; it does not imply endorsement by or affiliation with the author.
